Travel southwest to drive off a group of [[Grawl Invader]]s. [[Warmaster Grast]] will provision you with a [[Starter Sword]] and teach you some fundamental [[sword skills]] to help deal with this threat.

==Quest information==
===Requirements===
{{ Standard prerequisites
| campaign = pre
| test = y
| profession = warrior
| primary = y
| secondary = n
}}

===Objectives===
* Look for Grawl invaders along the road. Eliminate them.
* Return to Warmaster Grast for your reward.

===Early benefits===
* Upon accepting the quest, Warmaster Grast will provide you with a [[Starter Sword]] and give you the following skills:
** {{skill icon|Sever Artery}}
** {{skill icon|Gash}}
** {{skill icon|Healing Signet}}

===Reward===
* 250 [[Experience]]

==Walkthrough==
Two of your newly acquired skills, Sever Artery and Gash require a sword to function. Equip the [[Starter Sword]] provided by Warmaster Grast and head southwest down the road. Along the way, you will encounter several non-hostile [[Stone Elemental]]s. You may try out your sword skills on them to learn that these creatures of earth are immune to [[Bleeding]], rendering your new condition-based combo ineffective.

Continue past the elementals to find a a patrol of three Grawl Invaders close by. Being flesh and blood, they are susceptible to your blade. Use your basic attack to build up your [[Adrenaline]]. Once you have amassed 3 strikes of Adrenaline, use Sever Artery to inflict the Bleeding condition. When you reach 5 strikes of Adrenaline, follow up with Gash to inflict a [[Deep Wound]] on the bleeding target. Notice that each [[adrenal skill]] has its own independent Adrenaline pool.

Once the Grawl threat has been eliminated, return to Grast to claim your reward.

==Dialogue==
===Initial dialogue===
;Warmaster Grast
:''"I should warn you that there's trouble on the road. A group of '''Grawl invaders''' have camped out not far from here, and have been harassing travelers. If you'd like, I can teach you a thing or two to help drive them off. I'll even lend you a sword if you need one."''
{{ Offer dialog
| accept = These creatures must be taught a lesson!
| decline = I don't think I'm ready to take them on.
| ask = Not afraid of a few Grawl are you? Just head up the road and use the sword skills I showed you. Eliminate the '''Grawl invaders''' and report back to me.
}}

===Reward dialogue===
;Warmaster Grast
:''"Ah, that's a relief. The only good grawl's a dead Grawl, I say."''

==Trivia==
* Unlike the other quests required to get a secondary profession in Pre-Searing ([[A Monk's Mission]], [[The Ranger's Companion]], [[A Mesmer's Burden]],  [[The Elementalist Experiment]] and [[The Necromancer's Novice]]), this quest does not feature the profession in its name. Considering that there is another quest called [[Warrior's Challenge]], it may have been that these two quests were originally meant to be swapped during development.

{{Anomaly|The three Grawl Invaders are not technically part of the quest spawn. As a result, they can be found roaming the roadside both before accepting the quest and after its completion.}}
